### Q9NS91 — E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase RAD18
- Organism: Homo sapiens
- Reviewed: True
- Source: local_uniprot_swissprot_xml
- Homology: identity=49.2%, query coverage=98.6%, target coverage=98.8%, E-value=2.31e-137
- function: E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase involved in postreplication repair of UV-damaged DNA. Postreplication repair functions in gap-filling of a daughter strand on replication of damaged DNA. Associates to the E2 ubiquitin conjugating enzyme UBE2B to form the UBE2B-RAD18 ubiquitin ligase complex involved in mono-ubiquitination of DNA-associated PCNA on 'Lys-164'. Has ssDNA binding activity.
- pathway: Protein modification; protein ubiquitination.
- localization: Nucleus; Cytoplasm; Cytoskeleton; Microtubule organizing center; Centrosome; Associates with chromatin (PubMed:25931565). Colocalizes with SLF1 in the nucleus and to centrosomes (PubMed:15632077). Relocalizes with SLF1 to nuclear foci in response to DNA damage (PubMed:22036607). Accumulates with the SLF1-SLF2 and SMC5-SMC6 complexes at replication-coupled DNA interstrand repair and DNA double-strand breaks (DSBs) sites on chromatin in a ubiquitin-dependent manner (PubMed:25931565).
- subunit: Homodimer (PubMed:21549715). Interacts with UBE2A and UBE2B, one homodimer binding one molecule of UBE2B. Interacts with SHPRH (PubMed:17108083, PubMed:17130289). Interacts with HLTF (PubMed:18316726, PubMed:18719106). Interacts with SPRTN; leading to enhance chromatin association of RAD18 and RAD18-mediated PCNA ubiquitination and translesion DNA synthesis (PubMed:22681887). Interacts (via C-terminus and phosphorylated form) with SLF1 (via BRCT domains); this interaction is required for efficient repair of UV-induced DNA damage (PubMed:15632077, PubMed:22036607, PubMed:25931565). Interacts with SLF2 (PubMed:25931565). Interacts with SMC5; this interaction is increased in a SLF1 or SLF2-dependent manner (PubMed:25931565). Interacts with DNA damage up-regulated protein DDUP (PubMed:35849344). Forms a complex with DDUP and H2AX following DDUP phosphorylation (PubMed:35849344).

entities.name: RAD18
observations: The 501-residue sequence has 49.2% identity and 98.6% coverage to reviewed human RAD18 (UniProt Q9NS91).
The sequence contains a C3HC4 RING-type zinc-finger domain at residues 25–64, a UBZ4 zinc-binding region around residues 201–228, and a SAP domain at residues 255–289.
RAD18 is an E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase that functions with an E2 enzyme to monoubiquitinate PCNA during DNA-damage tolerance.

entities.name: PCNA monoubiquitination
observations: The documented RAD18 reaction transfers ubiquitin from the catalytic cysteine of an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme to the epsilon-amino group of a lysine residue on an acceptor protein; the physiological acceptor is PCNA Lys164.
Reaction class: S-ubiquitinyl-E2 cysteine + acceptor-protein lysine → deubiquitinated E2 + N6-ubiquitinyl-acceptor-protein lysine.

entities.name: PCNA
observations: PCNA is the physiological substrate reported for RAD18-mediated monoubiquitination, specifically at Lys164 in DNA-damage tolerance.

entities.name: UBE2B
observations: RAD18 associates with the E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme UBE2B to form the ubiquitin-ligase complex that modifies PCNA.
